title: RoutineDeliveryFailedPayload

routineId.description: A routine's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints, so a create can queue offline.

name.description: A routine's name: 1 to 40 characters once trimmed, no control or format (zero-width) characters, so it is also a valid tag; stored trimmed, unique per environment ignoring case.

entryId.description: The firing or skip that could not be delivered.

endpoint.description: The endpoint the webhook target names.

error.description: Why the last attempt failed: the status, the network error, or a missing endpoint or secret.

description: routine.delivery-failed: a webhook delivery failed finally, after its retries or at once; every connected client raises it.
